ITEM 1 | Cream-colored, pale off-white porridge-like mass with fine granular texture and a slightly glossy, moist surface, filling most of a white cereal bowl (about 15 cm across) to a depth of roughly 2-3 cm; soft, holds a loose spoonable shape, with small visible grains/particles throughout | 250
ITEM 2 | Dark purple-black berries, glossy and plump with rounded bumpy drupelet surfaces, about 2-2.5 cm each, roughly 12 pieces clustered on the upper-left and center of the porridge surface, partly sunk into the pale mass | 130
ITEM 3 | Bright red raspberries, matte and slightly soft with clustered drupelet texture, about 1.5-2 cm each, heaped in a separate white bowl (about 10 cm across) at the upper-left edge of the frame, some pieces slightly darker red | 110
